title: Element
description: Select elements of lists or dicts using python syntax like col[0]['key'].

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: Name of the input column and sub elements This permits by index for lists or dict and by key for dicts e.g. col[0]['key'] // [{"key":"val"}] -> "val".

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: Set the default value to return if the specified element doesn't exist.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Select elements of lists or dictionaries using Python syntax like `col[1:3]['key']`. ## Migrated examples #### Selecting The First Element ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - select.element: input: Column A[0] output: First Element ```
##### Input Sample | Column A | | --- | | [A, 0.9] | | [B, 0.8] |
##### Output Sample | Column A | First Element | | --- | --- | | [A, 0.9] | A | | [B, 0.8] | B |
